data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: Unit tests written and passing for all new/modified logic (documentation supports this by documenting the config key behavior)

## Implementation Notes
Doc router: Gate 2 fires — content extends material already in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (config keys reference doc).
Target: plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

Add or update the following sections:
1. **dso.workflow key** — document as the canonical key replacing the four legacy keys; values: `local | ci-pr`
2. **Legacy keys lockout** — document the four deprecated keys (`merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`); note that after migration sentinel exists, reading them via read-config.sh exits 1 with a recovery message
3. **Sentinel file** — document `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` as the migration marker; note that it must be committed (not gitignored) for the lockout to activate; note the gitignore reminder from the migrator
4. **Recovery command** — document `git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf` as the recovery path if a legacy key is encountered post-migration

Do NOT edit CLAUDE.md directly. This task emits DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION upon completion.

## TDD Exemption
Criterion 3: static assets only — documentation file with no executable behavior. No RED test required.

The only verifiable assertions are structural (file exists, key terms present).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md references dso.workflow as canonical key
  Verify: grep -q 'dso.workflow' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents the four legacy keys as deprecated
  Verify: grep -q 'merge.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md && grep -q 'deprecated\|lockout\|legacy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents the sentinel file path
  Verify: grep -q '\.dso-config-v2-migrated' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents the recovery command
  Verify: grep -q 'git checkout HEAD' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Sub-agent emits DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in completion report (Gate 2 → CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md)
  Verify: (attestation emitted in sub-agent output — orchestrator verifies in completion report)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with dso.workflow lockout and sentinel documentation
